t: The $(5)Stabilization Module$() may be used in a $(l:mffs:machines/projector)Force Field Projector$() to crystallise the field into a solid form. Instead of creating an energy field barrier that disappears when it is turned off, the Projector replaces the field with real blocks supplied by the player.
$(5)稳定模块$()可用于$(l:mffs:machines/projector)力场投影仪$()，将力场结晶为实体形态。投射器不再生成关闭后即消失的能量屏障，而是以玩家提供的真实方块来替代力场。

In this manner, the $(5)Stabilization Module$() makes it possible to produce an exact physical replica of a force field pattern that remains after the Projector is deactivated. Because the field is constructed using actual blocks, its durability corresponds to that of the blocks. However, as long as the Projector is sufficiently powered and supplied with enough replacement blocks, it will continually regenerate the field structure if it is broken.
通过这种方式，$(5)稳定模块$()使得力场图案能够以精确的物理复制品形式留存下来，即使投射器已被停用亦不例外。由于该结构由真实方块构建而成，其耐久度即等同于所用方块的耐久度。然而，只要投射器供电充足且备有足够替换方块，一旦结构受损，投射器便会持续再生修复该力场结构。

The stabilization (transposition) process requires more $(l:mffs:getting_started/fortron)Fortron$() and is slower than normal field projection; but if used in combination with the $(l:mffs:projector_modes/custom_mode)$(2)Custom Mode$() feature of a Projector, its conceivable applications are virtually limitless. For example, a player could create a structure that was automatically repaired whenever a $(2)Creeper$() tried to blow it up. Adding $(l:mffs:upgrade_modules/speed_module)$(5)Speed Module$()s into a Projector allows multiple blocks to be stabilized at once.

稳定化（转置）过程需要更多的$(l:mffs:getting_started/fortron)力场子$()，且比普通力场投射更慢；但若与投射器的$(l:mffs:projector_modes/custom_mode)$(2)自定义模式$()功能结合使用，其潜在应用几乎是无限的。例如，玩家可以构建一种结构，当有$(2)苦力怕$()试图将其炸毁时，该结构会自动修复。在投射器中添加$(l:mffs:upgrade_modules/speed_module)$(5)速度模块$()，即可同时稳定多个方块。

$(li)Place a chest next to the $(l:mffs:machines/projector)Force Field Projector$() (any side) and make sure it contains the required blocks to build the field up.$(li)Insert a Field Stabilization Module into the Projector's matrix slots. Setup the field as your wish and then activate the Projector.$(li)The Projector will consume blocks from adjacent chests in the order that they appear. If a chest contains a mixture of different blocks, the target structure will also be composed of a block mixture.$()
$(li)在$(l:mffs:machines/projector)力场投影仪$()旁（任意一侧）放置一个箱子，并确保箱内装有构建力场所需的方块。$(li)将力场稳定模块插入投射器的矩阵插槽中。按您的意愿设置力场，随后激活投射器。$(li)投射器将按相邻箱子中方块的排列顺序依次消耗方块。若箱子内混有多种方块，则目标结构也将由混合方块构成。$()
A Force Field Projector stabilizing a wall using the $(5)Stabilization Module$().
一个力场投影仪正使用$(5)稳定模块$()稳定一堵墙。

Unlike the other modes available for the $(l:mffs:machines/projector)Force Field Projector$(), the $(l:mffs:projector_modes/custom_mode)$(2)Custom Mode$() item stores the precise position and type of each block it analyses. As a result, the stabilization process for the $(l:mffs:projector_modes/custom_mode)$(2)Custom Mode$() does not work in the same way. Instead of consuming blocks in their order of appearance and transposing them to arbitrary locations; the Projector will take only the block types that match the original pattern.

与其他适用于$(l:mffs:machines/projector)力场投影仪$()的模式不同，$(l:mffs:projector_modes/custom_mode)$(2)自定义模式$()物品会精确记录其所分析的每个方块的位置与类型。因此，$(l:mffs:projector_modes/custom_mode)$(2)自定义模式$()的固化过程运作方式亦不相同：投射器不会按方块出现顺序消耗方块并将其位移到任意位置，而是仅提取与原始图案相匹配的方块类型。

Each block is placed exactly as it should be according to its type and position. If a Projector runs out of the matching block types necessary to replicate a pattern, it will pause until they are provided.
每个方块都将严格按照其类型与位置精准放置。若投射器耗尽了复制图案所需的匹配方块类型，它将暂停操作，直至补足相应方块。
